chromatic_floor_correction.note: Panel Iteration 17 Phase 5, Red Team finding F2 (independently caught by 5 of 6 blind seats -- VISION, PHOTONICS, QUANTUM OPTICS, ELECTROMAGNETISM, THERMODYNAMICS -- confirmed load-bearing by Red Team's own audit, fix L-A). Block V's own empty-scene C differs by a near-constant additive offset between 450nm and 600nm (+9.2238e-4) -- this accounts for 90-100% of the RAW chromatic spread at every article in this family, including the originally-cited exp-026 'off_lab 16.8%' comparator (~100% floor per Red Team's re-derivation), which was ALREADY known floor-driven on this program's own record for sponge-class articles (exp-024/Iteration 2: absorber Delta=0.0114, PEC Delta=0.0166, sponge Delta=0.0003 'noise-level'). Once floor-corrected, the RESIDUAL chromatic spread runs the OPPOSITE direction from the raw metric -- it INCREASES with tau, not decreases -- because the raw metric is mechanically (near-constant offset)/(growing |C|). Chromatic (lambda) and resolution (cpl) are also perfectly collinear in this bench design (V_CPL={450:15,600:20} at fixed dx=30nm) -- Block R's own R3 measurement (0.158% shift for a 1.5x cpl change at v2) exceeds v2's entire floor-corrected residual, so no chromatic PHYSICS beyond known grid-resolution sensitivity is needed to explain it either. P-EXP040-2a/2b are RE-VERDICTED (see each prediction's own 'reverdict_phase5' field): arithmetically CONFIRMED as pre-registered, but floor-dominated / uninformative about real chromatic physics, not evidence of a fast-saturating chromatic-flatness law as originally read in NOTES.md.

thermo_sidecar_v1_v2.note: Panel Iteration 17 Phase 5, THERMODYNAMICS' own self-reported charter gap (this cycle's lead seat never computed its own sidecar for v1/v2 during Phase 1-4), filled at Phase 5 and Red-Team-adjudicated (fix L-F). Post-run analytic sidecar, NOT an FDTD output -- expressibility contract. Uses this program's own established exp-033/034 linear-in-absorbed-fraction rescaling convention, with `chord_absorptance_exact` (this cycle's own defect-fixed replacement for exp-034's unphysical weak-tau series) as the absorbed-fraction link. REF_DT_SS_K and REF_RATE_K_PER_S are UNSOURCED bare literals, flagged unsourced for a sixth consecutive cycle (THERMODYNAMICS' own standing complaint) -- treat all numbers below as order-of-magnitude, not final. FINDING: v2 (tau=2.063) is the FIRST article in this program's 17-iteration history whose predicted thermal signature crosses ABOVE an uncooled-microbolometer NETD band, at both steady-state and 1s dwell; v1 straddles it. Red-Team-corrected framing (both corrections push the same direction, neither is bounded): (1) NOT a Tier-A exposure -- both articles exceed the Tier-A VISIBLE-band lab bar by 50-133x, so this is not a novel Tier-A failure; the correct, narrower, still-novel claim is that in the scotopic Tier-W-adjacent regime the THERMAL channel may bind before the VISUAL channel does, for the first time in this program. (2) 'DETECTABLE' is PARCEL-FRAME only, not apparent-at-a-real-imager: a ~2.34um parcel against a ~17-25um microbolometer pixel pitch implies a ~100x pixel-fill-factor dilution, and an object several times smaller than the 8-14um thermal wavelength has emissivity well below 1 in that band -- either correction alone plausibly returns v2 below NETD; neither is quantified here. (3) The verdict is DWELL-DECIDED over exactly this program's own still-unsourced T3 window (10ms-1s, docket #7): at 10ms, v2 reads 19-48x BELOW NETD (undetectable); at 1s, 2.1-5.3x ABOVE (detectable).
